sentence_stem: It is essential that the committee
correct_completion: approve the revised budget before the deadline.
full_sentence: It is essential that the committee approve the revised budget before the deadline.
acceptable_variants: approve the revised budget without further delay.
sign off on the revised budget in time.

options.text: approved the revised budget before the deadline.
options.why_wrong: The past form is indicative and does not fit the subjunctive clause that follows 'it is essential that'.

options.text: approve the revised budget before the deadline.
will approve the revised budget before the deadline.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' is not used in a subjunctive clause after 'it is essential that'; the base form is required.

options.text: approves the revised budget before the deadline.
options.why_wrong: The third-person -s form is indicative; the subjunctive uses the plain base form for all subjects.

grammar_focus: Mandative subjunctive after 'it is essential that'
explanation: After expressions of necessity such as 'it is essential that', English uses the plain base form of the verb for every subject.
translation: Jest konieczne, aby komisja zatwierdziła zmieniony budżet przed terminem.
